_comment: 2026-11-27 readout mine H: two company-stated readouts from leads (Compugen, Abivax); every row re-opened by an independent red-team pass. Also: the Vir ECLIPSE 3 row added 2026-11-26 duplicated an existing ECLIPSE 3 row and is removed.
